name: Linvala
description: An angel who backed Tazri's plan and helped defeat Nahiri.

timeline.summary: The halos of oppression have shattered, heralding a new generation of freed angels such as Linvala.
timeline.quote: It may be in the spirit of that defiance that the halos of oppression have shattered.

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After the Eldrazi fall, Commander Tazri drafts a rebuilding plan backed by Linvala and Sea Gate is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Within a year, the city was restored.

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fed up with the expeditionary houses' infighting, Tazri drafts her own plan for Sea Gate, which Linvala backs, and the city is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Fed up with the houses' infighting, Tazri drafted a plan of her own.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri drafts her own rebuilding plan for Sea Gate, backed by the angel Linvala, and the city is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Within a year, the city was restored.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
timeline.quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala reports that the lithomancer has returned, though not as an ally.
timeline.quote: "She has not returned as an ally."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala carries Tazri away as Sea Gate falls to the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: From above, Tazri watches in horror as her home is, again, consumed by creatures not from this plane.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala brings Tazri to Akiri's party, and they agree they are the only ones left to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
timeline.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
timeline.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
timeline.quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
timeline.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is lost.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Akiri leads her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave, leaping into the sky and catching a hedron with her rope.
timeline.quote: But Akiri is a master line-slinger and midway through their failing arc, she lets her rope fly.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tazri's party, empowered by Halo, breaks Nahiri loose and the Skyclave crashes with her inside.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave broke and crashed to the ground with her still inside

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Tazri leads the defense of Sea Gate and sends Akiri, Linvala, Kaza and Orah to investigate her vision of Nahiri's return.
timeline.quote: She received a halo-blessed vision of the return of Nahiri

citation.text: "Tazri", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri and the party attack Nahiri in the Emeri Skyclave, break her loose from the Hedron network, and the Skyclave crashes with Nahiri inside.
timeline.quote: they witnessed the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri's party, aided by Linvala and Halo, breaks Nahiri loose from the hedron network as the Skyclave crashes down with her inside.
timeline.quote: they witnessed the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: Nahiri is cured of compleation by unclear means.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, another planeswalker, was also cured of compleation

citation.text: "Compleation", section "Healing Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akiri, Linvala, Kaza, Orah and Tazri fought the compleated Nahiri in Emeria's Skyclave, which crashed with her inside.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

citation.text: "Akiri", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drana and Linvala fight side by side in the skies and grow to respect one another.
timeline.quote: eventually an appreciation for each other’s unique strengths and combat prowess

citation.text: "Drana", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri sends Akiri, Linvala, Kaza and Orah to Emeria, where they see compleated Nahiri return.
timeline.quote: where they witnessed the return of the compleated Nahiri

citation.text: "Kaza", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party fights Nahiri and breaks her from the Hedron network; the Skyclave crashes with her inside.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

citation.text: "Kaza", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linvala survives the Eldrazi release and joins the fight against Kozilek.
timeline.quote: Linvala survived the initial release of the Eldrazi and joined the fight against the titan Kozilek

citation.text: "Linvala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linvala flies to Sea Gate, tired of other angels' inaction, and backs Tazri's reconstruction proposal.
timeline.quote: flew to Sea Gate to offer her services

citation.text: "Linvala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party, including Linvala, fights compleated Nahiri at Emeria and breaks her from the Hedron network.
timeline.quote: the party managed to break Nahiri loose from the reformed Hedron network and knock her from her feet

citation.text: "Linvala", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linvala and Drana fight in the same skies and come to respect each other.
timeline.quote: bloodchief magic and angelic powers complemented each other surprisingly well

citation.text: "Linvala", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri sends the party to Emeria, where they witness the return of the compleated Nahiri.
timeline.quote: they witnessed the return of the compleated Nahiri

citation.text: "Orah", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party breaks Nahiri loose from the Hedron network and Linvala burns the oil from Orah's hand; the Skyclave crashes with Nahiri inside.
timeline.quote: Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

citation.text: "Orah", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: gradually evolved into a grudging respect

citation.text: "Drana", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The angel Linvala immediately stood behind her proposal

citation.text: "Tazri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
